models_evaluated: six large language models (unnamed in abstract)

links.outcome: Gap between structured multiple-choice exam-style accuracy and open-ended multimodal clinical task accuracy
links.effect: Accuracy exceeded 90% on structured multiple-choice questions but scarcely reached 60% on open-ended tasks requiring multimodal integration.
links.quote: While state-of-the-art models achieved high accuracy, exceeding 90%, on structured multiple-choice questions, their performance markedly declined on open-ended tasks requiring multimodal integration, with accuracy scarcely reaching 60%.

screen.reason: The study develops and executes an automated benchmark (B&J Benchmark) across 17 vision-language and large language models to evaluate clinical reasoning and multimodal capabilities on orthopedic cases.
